page.overview:
Who is Acne Man 2?

Acne Man 2 is an employee of Acne Grease Co. and Acne Grease and Shovel. Along with Acne Man 1, he collected the deep fryer grease from Krusty Burger, stealing the grease that Homer and Bart Simpson had put into the Pink Sedan. He and his partner considered themselves dominant in the grease business of Springfield.
